topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Yeah, I got the memo. Congratulations, I suppose. New department, fresh faces. Must be a real step-up, right? Only thing is, I've got a hunch it’s the same old two-way mirror, just a different reflection every time I look. They tell me it’s safer over there, more secure. But I’ve seen how secure goes when the suits decide a guy’s expendable. I’ll bet you anything it’s the same over there, just as quiet, just as cold. You think about that, and maybe, just maybe, keep your eyes open. I’m never around when the good stuff goes down, but I’ll be damned if I don’t know how the other guy plays his cards.
